data.name: Tray_Tooltip
data.comment: The notification-area icon's tooltip.

data.name: Menu_Open
data.comment: Tray menu; _ marks the access key.

data.name: Menu_CheckForUpdates
data.comment: Tray menu: checks now and opens the Updates page.

data.name: Health_DeviceDescription
data.value: The same snapshot as Health in Revit: hardware, display and network, the Revit versions installed, Windows, and the junk files Revit leaves behind. Revit doesn't need to be open. Nothing is sent anywhere.

data.name: Health_ModelsPlaceholder
data.value: Every model you've worked on, across your Revit versions, will be listed here.

data.name: Updates_Description
data.value: Once a day, RST asks GitHub whether a newer RST, Gantt-It or Splash-It is out, and tells you when one is.

data.name: Apps_Description
data.value: RST, Gantt-It and Splash-It: which are installed for you on this PC, and the latest version of each.

data.name: Settings_ThemeHint
data.value: System follows your Windows app theme.

data.name: Settings_CheckForUpdatesHint
data.value: Once a day, RST asks GitHub whether a newer RST, Gantt-It or Splash-It is available. It sends nothing about you or your models, and installs nothing until you click.

data.name: Settings_CheckForUpdatesLocked
data.value: Turned off on this computer by whoever manages its software.
data.comment: Shown when the UpdateChecks=0 registry preset forces checks off.

data.name: Settings_SaveFailed
data.value: Couldn't save the setting. Details are in the log.

data.name: Settings_VersionFormat
data.comment: {0} is the version, e.g. 3.1.0.

data.name: Settings_StartupHint
data.value: RST starts when you sign in to Windows. To stop that, turn RST off in Task Manager under Startup apps.

data.name: Footer_RunsInTray
data.value: RST keeps running in the notification area. Quit it from the icon's menu.

data.name: Notice_Message
data.value:
Once a day, the RST tray asks GitHub whether a newer RST, Gantt-It or Splash-It is available, and tells you when one is. It sends nothing about you or your models, and it installs nothing until you click Install.
To turn this off, open RST from the notification area and go to Settings.
data.comment: The one-time first-run notice (modelled on the former telemetry first-run notice).

data.name: Shadow_Message
data.value:
RST is installed both for you and for everyone on this PC. Revit uses your own copy, not the shared one.
To use the shared one, remove "RST" in Settings > Apps, and keep "RST (all users)". Your profiles and settings stay.
data.comment: F17 WU5: shown once when the user's own RST.msi hides RST-Machine.msi (spec #20 §7). Information only.

data.name: Updates_LastCheckedToday
data.comment: {0} is the local time, e.g. 09:14.

data.name: Updates_LastCheckedYesterday
data.comment: {0} is the local time, e.g. 09:14.

data.name: Updates_LastCheckedOn
data.comment: {0} is the local date (28 Oct 2026), {1} the local time.

data.name: Updates_RstAvailable
data.comment: {0} is the latest version, e.g. 3.1.1.

data.name: Updates_RstInstalled
data.comment: The headline when the latest version is not known yet. {0} is the installed version.

data.name: Updates_RstUnknown
data.comment: The headline when RST's installed version is not known (not installed by RST.msi, e.g. a developer build).

data.name: Updates_ChecksOff
data.value: Automatic checks are off. Check now asks GitHub once, only when you click it.

data.name: Updates_ChecksOffLocked
data.value: Automatic checks were turned off on this computer by whoever manages its software. Check now still asks GitHub when you click it.

data.name: Updates_CheckFailed
data.value: Couldn't check: {0}. RST tries again at the next daily check. Details are in the log.
data.comment: {0} is why, e.g. "no answer in 30 s" or "HTTP 407".

data.name: Updates_LastSuccessToday
data.comment: Shown after a failed check. {0} is the local time.

data.name: Apps_DetectionFailed
data.value: Couldn't read the installed apps from Windows Installer, so their state is unknown. Details are in the log.

data.name: App_LatestFailedKnown
data.comment: {0} is the last known latest version, kept after a failed check.

data.name: State_Unknown
data.comment: Windows Installer could not be read for this app.

data.name: Updates_RstUpdateNote
data.value: RST closes while it updates, then opens again. Nothing is installed while Revit is open.
data.comment: Beside RST's Update button, with the Release page link (F17 WU4).

data.name: Apps_InstallsNote
data.value: Installs are for your account only and need no administrator. RST checks each download against its release before installing it, and never installs while Revit is open.

data.name: App_InstalledForYou
data.comment: {0} is the installed version. A per-user install.

data.name: App_InstalledForYouManaged
data.comment: {0} is the installed version. A per-user install made by Group Policy.

data.name: App_InstalledForEveryone
data.comment: {0} is the installed version. A per-machine install.

data.name: App_ManualNote
data.value: Installed manually: updates not managed by RST.
data.comment: Shown when the add-in's .addin is present but Windows Installer has no product for it.

data.name: App_InstallWhenRevitCloses
data.comment: The Install button while Revit runs (spec #20 §5): a click waits for Revit to exit, then installs.

data.name: App_ReinstallPrevious
data.comment: After a failed upgrade left the app uninstalled (spec #20 §5). {0} is the previous version, e.g. 1.1.0.

data.name: App_ReinstallPreviousWhenRevitCloses
data.comment: The reinstall button while Revit runs (the reinstall waits for Revit too). {0} is the previous version.

data.name: State_Installed
data.comment: Installed, the latest version not known yet.

data.name: Notify_OneTitle
data.comment: The tray notification. {0} the product (RST), {1} the version (3.1.1).

data.name: Notify_OneText
data.value: Click to see it in RST.

data.name: Notify_ManyTitle
data.comment: The tray notification when one check finds several new versions.

data.name: Notify_ManyText
data.value: {0}. Click to see them in RST.
data.comment: {0} lists them: "RST 3.1.1, Gantt-It 1.2.0".

data.name: Install_WaitingForRevit
data.value: Waiting for Revit to close. {0} {1} installs as soon as it does.

data.name: Install_Queued
data.value: Waiting its turn: {0} {1} installs when the installation before it has finished.
data.comment: F17 WU4 review B1: one install at a time.

data.name: Install_QueuedRst
data.value: RST {1} updates once the other installs have finished, so none of them is lost when RST restarts.

data.name: Install_RetryLater
data.value: Another installation is running. RST tries {0} {1} again in a few minutes.

data.name: Install_HandingOff
data.value: Updating RST to {1}. RST closes now and opens again when it is done.

data.name: Install_DoneRestart
data.value: {0} {1} is installed. Restart Windows to finish; RST never restarts it for you.

data.name: Install_Refused
data.value: RST didn't install {0} {1}: {2}. Nothing was changed.
data.comment: {2} is a plain reason (Problem_* or Net_*). The detail is in the tray log.

data.name: Install_Failed
data.value: Couldn't install {0} {1}: Windows Installer stopped with error {2}. The log has the details.

data.name: Install_FailedGone
data.value: Couldn't update {0} to {1}: Windows Installer stopped with error {2}, and {0} is no longer installed. Reinstall the previous version to get it back; the log has the details.

data.name: Install_Busy
data.value: Another installation kept running, so {0} {1} wasn't installed. Try again later.

data.name: Install_UpdaterFailed
data.value: Couldn't start RST's updater, so RST {1} wasn't installed. Details are in the log.

data.name: Install_PerMachineRst
data.value: RST {1} is available. It's installed for everyone on this PC, so run RST-Setup.exe as an administrator or ask whoever manages software here.
data.comment: Spec #20 §5's wording for a per-machine RST, shown with the Release page link.

data.name: Install_PerMachine
data.value: {0} {1} is available. It's installed for everyone on this PC, so ask whoever manages software here to update it.

data.name: Problem_NotInstallable
data.value: RST doesn't know this app's installer

data.name: Problem_AssetNameBad
data.value: the release's installer has an unexpected name

data.name: Problem_NotNewer
data.value: it isn't newer than the version installed

data.name: Problem_RedirectNotAllowed
data.value: the download was sent somewhere other than GitHub

data.name: Problem_NotInSums
data.value: the release's SHA256SUMS.txt doesn't list the installer

data.name: Problem_DigestMissing
data.value: GitHub gives no checksum for the installer

data.name: Problem_DigestMismatch
data.value: the release's two checksums don't agree

data.name: Problem_HashMismatch
data.value: the download doesn't match its checksum

data.name: Problem_TooLarge
data.value: the download is larger than expected

data.name: Problem_MsiUnreadable
data.value: the download isn't a readable installer

data.name: Problem_WrongUpgradeCode
data.value: the installer is for a different app

data.name: Problem_WrongVersion
data.value: the installer's version isn't the release's

data.name: Problem_WrongScope
data.value: the installer would install for everyone on this PC

data.name: Problem_DiskError
data.value: the download couldn't be saved on this PC

data.name: Problem_DetectionFailed
data.value: RST couldn't tell what is installed

data.name: Net_Offline
data.comment: A network failure, in plain words (WU3 review D3). Also used for "Couldn't check: {0}".

data.name: Net_RateLimited
data.value: GitHub asked RST to wait; try again in an hour
